red_evidence.note: Test authored fresh as integration suite. Initial draft used STATUS_TEAPOT (418) + assertNotNull(responseMessage); both produced organic red signals. (a) HTTP 418 routed HttpURLConnection.getInputStream() through the 4xx error path raising IOException — confirmed 2-arg setStatus status code does propagate; (b) After switching to 201 Created, assertNotNull(responseMessage) failed because Tomcat 10.0/10.1/11.0 emit no reason phrase on the wire, so HttpURLConnection.getResponseMessage() returns null — this very absence proves the SRS §6.2.2 E1 policy: jakarta.servlet 6.0+ removed setStatus(int, String) and the adapter drops the reason phrase. Test was refined to treat null responseMessage as positive evidence (reason phrase fully dropped) and only assert absence of CUSTOM_REASON when responseMessage is non-null. Pattern matches IT10CharsetTest (servlet5/6/61 trio) authoring style.

impl_iters.note: 3 parallel test classes (one per servlet module: 5/6/61). Each contains 2 @Test methods: shouldIgnoreReasonPhrase (deprecated 2-arg setStatus(201, CUSTOM_REASON) — asserts status==201, custom reason phrase MUST NOT appear on HTTP status line (null responseMessage is acceptable / positive signal), body marker 'two-arg-invoked') + shouldSetStatusCode (1-arg setStatus(202) — asserts status==202, body marker 'one-arg-invoked'). Modules differ only by ServletConverter import (servletElementConverter5/6/61) and Tomcat version mentioned in javadoc. 2-arg overload annotated @SuppressWarnings("deprecation") since Servlet 4.0 deprecated this signature.

dod_check.notes: shouldIgnoreReasonPhrase: GET → javax HttpServlet calls resp.setStatus(201, 'Custom-Brew-Phrase') (deprecated 2-arg overload, @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")). javax→jakarta bridge (ServletConverter.convert) → Tomcat → HTTP wire → client. Client observes status==201 (status code preserved) and responseMessage either null or standard reason phrase — never the application-supplied 'Custom-Brew-Phrase'. Verified across Tomcat 10.0.27 (servlet5), 10.1.30 (servlet6), 11.0.0 (servlet61). SRS §6.2.2 policy E1 satisfied: jakarta 6.0+ removed the API entirely, adapter delegates to setStatus(int) only.

shouldSetStatusCode: GET → javax HttpServlet calls resp.setStatus(202). javax→jakarta bridge → Tomcat → HTTP wire → client. Client observes status==202, body 'one-arg-invoked' confirming 1-arg path executed correctly. No reason phrase manipulation involved.
